cards.title: Housing First programs
cards.response_what: Permanent supportive housing for people experiencing homelessness with a disabling condition, without requiring sobriety or treatment first.
cards.insight_mechanism: Stable housing first makes treatment and services easier to use.

cards.title: Tenant-based housing vouchers
cards.response_what: Rental vouchers that low-income families use to rent homes on the private market.
cards.insight_mechanism: Lower rent burden frees income for food, health care and stability.

cards.title: Ignition interlocks for drunk-driving offenders
cards.response_what: Breath-test devices installed in vehicles of people convicted of alcohol-impaired driving.
cards.insight_mechanism: The car will not start if the driver has been drinking, preventing repeat offenses.

cards.title: Child safety seat distribution and education
cards.response_what: Programs that give out car seats and teach parents to install them correctly.
cards.insight_mechanism: Correctly used car seats reduce injuries to children in crashes.

cards.title: Home visits to increase vaccination
cards.response_what: Health workers visit families at home to deliver or arrange vaccinations.
cards.insight_mechanism: Removing travel and scheduling barriers raises immunization rates.

cards.title: Client reminder and recall for vaccination
cards.response_what: Text, phone and mail reminders telling patients when vaccines are due or overdue.
cards.insight_mechanism: Prompts at the right time overcome forgetting and missed appointments.

cards.title: Digital interventions to prevent teen substance use
cards.response_what: Apps, websites and text-message programs that teach adolescents skills to avoid alcohol, vaping and drugs.
cards.insight_mechanism: Interactive skills practice delivered where teens already spend time.

cards.title: Collaborative care for depression
cards.response_what: Primary care teams with a care manager and psychiatric consultant treat depression together.
cards.insight_mechanism: Systematic follow-up and stepped treatment catch patients who are not improving.

cards.title: Center-based early childhood education
cards.response_what: Publicly funded preschool programs for children ages three and four.
cards.insight_mechanism: Early learning builds cognitive and social skills that pay off in school.

cards.title: Dual enrollment programs
cards.response_what: High school students take college courses for credit before graduating.
cards.insight_mechanism: Early college credit raises expectations and shortens the path to a degree.

cards.title: School-based violence prevention programs
cards.response_what: Classroom programs that teach conflict resolution and social skills to reduce violent behavior.
cards.insight_mechanism: Students learn alternatives to aggression before conflicts escalate.

cards.title: Increasing alcohol taxes
cards.response_what: State and local tax increases on beer, wine and spirits.
cards.insight_mechanism: Higher prices reduce excessive drinking and its harms.
